Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you
were involved in in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my first name for now. It's fine to go ahead.
Q: That works. Can you tell me, in your own words, what happened leading up to the collision?
A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road, waiting to turn. I had my foot on the brake and I was looking at the
light, not really paying attention to anything else.
Q: What happened next?
A: The next thing I knew there was a loud bang and my car lurched forward. I was pushed into the intersection a little
bit. The other driver had been coming up behind me, and I don't think they stopped in time.
Q: Did you have a chance to see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Only in the mirror, for a second. It looked like it was moving faster than the traffic around it.
Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle at the scene?
A: Yes, but my wrist was really throbbing. I was holding it against my chest and I could barely grip anything.
Q: Did you seek medical attention that day?
A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They took X-rays and said the wrist was fractured. They put
me in a splint and gave me a referral to an orthopedic specialist.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment for the wrist?
A: Yes, I have a follow-up appointment next week. I'm wearing a brace most of the time and I'm not able to drive
comfortably yet.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want to make sure my medical bills and lost time from work get looked at fairly. I'm still figuring out the
full cost.
Q: Understood. This concludes the recorded statement. Thank you.
</page>
